notes.title: OPG Clanwars available 1.0
notes.content: [h2]Hey friends![/h2][p][/p][p]    Today is a big day for the OPG CW project as it leaves Early Access and I want to share some important news with you all! Unfortunately, the game hasn't gained much popularity on Steam, leading our team to reduce its size significantly. As a result, I'm now the only one left working on this project because we can't afford to pay programmers or other staff members anymore. From here on out, I'll be developing and updating the game by myself, but it's going to be challenging and updates won't come as frequently due to the sheer amount of work involved.[/p][p][/p][p]    I understand that there are several weak points in the current state of the project. Mechanics often feel unfinished and take too long to improve, workflows can be chaotic at times, and planning sometimes feels more like an adventure than a structured process. However, these challenges have become part of what makes OPG Clan Wars unique. The game has evolved through countless failures and experiments rather than adhering strictly to industry standards. It may not always look polished or balanced, but there's something raw and genuine about it that's hard to replicate elsewhere.[/p][p][/p][p]    Only I can decide when to close down the project, and right now, my plan is to keep pushing forward no matter how tough things get. Thank you so much to everyone who supports me along the way—your encouragement means everything and helps fuel my efforts towards making OPG Clan Wars even better![/p][p][/p][p]    It's definitely not easy maintaining and improving a game while also handling everything else solo. Updates will naturally slow down since they depend entirely on my personal contributions now. But despite these difficulties, I'm committed to continuing development and providing new content for both myself and fans alike.[/p][p][/p][p]   Hugs to everyone reading this message! And if anyone wants to join us online during launch week, please do drop by—we'll try to stay active together! I've fixed various bugs, optimized maps, and addressed many issues within the game itself already.[/p][p][/p][p]P.S.: These next few days might see increased activity from players thanks to Steam's promotion efforts. If you're interested in playing against live opponents or just hanging out, invite your buddies over and let's enjoy ourselves![/p][h3][/h3][h3]See you all soon! [/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, friends!

We are excited to present you latest update:
[/h3]

  [list]
[*]   Progress saving in single player mode has been added. Work on the single player mode is ongoing.
[*]     Chinese localization has been added.
[*]     New gunshot sounds have been included.
[*]     Some textures have been fixed.
[*]     Object rendering distances have been adjusted.
[*]     Optimization has been performed.
[*]     45 new loot positions have been added.
[*]     Locations have been improved.
[/list]

[b]There are still some issues we’re actively working on, and based on your feedback, we plan to fix most of them in the near future.

Thank you for being with us—we couldn’t do it without your support![/b]

 Regards,
The Anarchy Games Team.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[h3] Dear OPG Players: Clan Wars, [/h3]

We wanted to share that we have fixed some of the bugs you encountered. Here's what we've already worked on:

[list]
[*] The trading system has been improved
[*] Artificial Intelligence tweaked
[*] Fixed collisions of some objects
[*] Fixed bugs with cars. Bots now react to enemies in the vehicle. Bots can be hit by a car
[*] Lighting corrected
[*] Fixed some tree textures
[*] Added penetration of thin concrete objects
[*] Added 50 loot items.
[*] Adjusted loot drop percentage.
[*] Working on locations
[*] Fixed missing road on village map
[/list]

We sincerely apologize for the negative experience some of you have had while these issues were in place. As a small indie studio with a limited team, it took us a little longer to get it right, but we really appreciate your patience during this process.

We still have a list of bugs we're actively working on, and we intend to fix most of them based on your feedback in the coming time.

[h3]Thank you for being with us. We couldn't do it without your support!

Regards,
Anarchy Games team.[/h3]

notes.title: Update.
notes.content:
Hi friends, we have received a lot of messages and want to tell you about the fixes and changes made!

Work on NPCs continues. We have improved the logic of behaviour and increased the variety of loot.
We fixed bugs found by our community and made some optimisations on maps.

Dear friends, ATTENTION- if you can't connect to the server or there is a long loading time please write us, we hear that some players can't play and we want to fix it, but we need more information, as we connect to the servers instantly and have no problems with it.

The single-player mode has received an addition and now you can practice not only playing Raid, but now also in Team Combat.

We continue to fix bugs and add new content to the game and are also working on optimisation.
Add the game to your wishlist, it's very important for us!

Regards,
AnarchyGames!

notes.title: Clan Wars News
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone! 
We'd like to share with you our progress in developing the game![/h3]
[list]
[*]Night Vision Capability has been added:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40384578/2f5aa22461a00cc71c7162d0fdd996946bcef9bf.png[/img]
- It will be available in the shop and can be found on the map
- After death, the PUV stays in the corpse.
[*]New vehicles added:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40384578/c30097c57d85878b80173f114838b0c4752c1369.png[/img]
- Importantly, some of these machines will only be available for use by clans(this is in development)
[*]Extra heavy helmet added:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40384578/aa7357c5c48be59cb5c0cfca48775b43f8ab3aba.png[/img]
- It's worth noting that helmets and body armour in the game will give bonuses to protection, in return taking away a character's mobility/speed. Also, helmets with visor, will affect the player's field of vision accordingly, covering a significant area of the player's view. 
[*]It is now possible to use modules on Mosin Rifle and Kar98K. Also a new sniper sight is in development (on both rifles)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40384578/05a55e525e2d02d4fd925e4cc15f70e51c600cab.png[/img]
[*]Reworked the system of the player's weapon touching the wall/object. Previously the weapon was raised, preventing the player from firing, now the weapon slides back, giving the player a full range of action and options
[*]Redesigned pain effect to be more realistic:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40384578/277f12d625a30842fabfe48c8aee636ecc7f7927.png[/img]
[*]Working on maps and environments
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40384578/e95043354c3b16b1c85bb1b11fe14fe60a8e70d1.png[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Wait for the next news and don't forget to add the game to your wishlist, it's support for us! We invite you to participate in the closed alpha tests as well! Read more in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/3Gt9a2S8Fw]discord[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Development News
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello friends! 

We have some good news for you today. We're moving swiftly and confidently into development. Here's just a small part of what we've been working on and still are working on all this time:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][h3]VSS Vintorez has been added to the game.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40384578/09ea5eb34991bfb5460e57a2f3036514e1c2c787.png[/img]
- High accuracy.
- High bullet penetration to hit targets in body armour.
- Low noise and flameless firing.
- Small size and weight of the weapon, allowing snipers to use the rifle even at close range.
- At the same time, the VSS Vintorez cannot boast a high maximum sighting range.

[*][h3]Working on the VSK-94 and AS Val.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40384578/b5cc405d1244a197b7a16f324f9091b916e8dcd0.png[/img]
Characteristics of this weapon will be voiced later.

[*][h3]Now we get to the highlight - body armour![/h3]
So far, the body armor will cut some damage, which will give a huge advantage to owners of this machineːsteamhappyː To use it, you will need: a cover for the body armor and the body armor itself. A total of 3 pouches so far:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40384578/a678d3d5217f24e9f3357894f2c07e72f13fcf0c.png[/img]
There are also 3 types of armor plates: light, medium and heavy, each will have a different degree of protection and a different debuff to the character's speed. Plates and pouches can be combined as desired.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40384578/7563cb97c9c43bd828657b8ca0e738b2f099d983.png[/img]

[*][h3]Of course, every day we expand and refine the game locations.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40384578/6b74527051292c0a282e74146cdfbd5ed03cf1b7.png[/img]
There will be several maps: a basic winter map, a basic fall map and a few small map for DM/TDM close combat.

[/list]
[h3]Remember that we still have trumps up our sleeves, we will reveal them in due course. Wait for the next news and don't forget to add the game to your wish list, it's a support for us! There's more to come. Read more at our [url=https://discord.gg/4CdjQRwAm9]discord[/url][/h3]
